measures.label: Mean of Weekly Amount of Benefit

annotationMap.IV: ".." denotes a nil or negligible number of claimants or award amount based on a nil or negligible number of claimants.
annotationMap.V: From November 2017 State Pension data excludes persons with a ‘suspended’ account and should be treated as a break in series. A suspended account, when the department suspends payment, can occur for a number of reasons. Suspended cases may end and pensions put back into payment, at which point they will be shown in the next extract of data, or the suspension may end and the case terminated.
annotationMap.VI: Due to data quality issues, State Pension statistics for the Shetland Islands from August 2023 to August 2024 have been mapped into the 'Unknown' category. Overall caseload totals are not impacted. This category has been populated from November 2024 data onwards.
annotationMap.III: The 'Average Weekly Amount of Benefit' measure is based on the final benefit amount received by claimants, where applicable any additions to basic rates are captured in this measure. This includes protected payments for nSP, as such care should be taken when using the separate 'nSP Protected Payment' measure.
